**Finding submitted: deviation (WARRANTY).**

- **What the document has:** Section 9 "Warranties" (p0055–p0058) is limited to mutual corporate reps (organization, authority, enforceability, no conflicts) plus an HDI acknowledgement about the Globix Agreement. Sections 1.1–1.8 (HDI's Responsibilities) and Section 5 (Site management) impose delivery and operational obligations but contain no quality standard, no conformance warranty, and no warranty remedy.
- **Why it fails:** With no conformance warranty or remedy of any kind running to us, the clause falls short even of the fallback (90 days software / 30 days services with repair, replace or refund). No "AS IS" disclaimer exists, so this is not walk-away territory — the gap is an omission rather than an affirmative disclaimer.
- **Redline (validated, ok:true):** New Section 9(c) at the preferred position — professional and workmanlike Services, 90-day conformance of the Site to specifications approved under Section 5.2, compliance with laws, no malicious code, with re-performance/repair/replacement/refund as our remedy at HDI's option. The comment offers a shorter conformance period as a fallback.
